title: Choking Child (1–8 years)
immediate_warning: Act immediately. If the child cannot breathe, cough, or cry, begin back blows now.

immediate_warning_translations.en: Act immediately. If the child cannot breathe, cough, or cry, begin back blows now.
immediate_warning_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Act immediately. If the child cannot breathe, cough, or cry, begin back blows now.
immediate_warning_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Act immediately. If the child cannot breathe, cough, or cry, begin back blows now.
immediate_warning_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Act immediately. If the child cannot breathe, cough, or cry, begin back blows now.
immediate_warning_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Act immediately. If the child cannot breathe, cough, or cry, begin back blows now.

description: Choking in children is a life-threatening emergency. A blocked airway can cause brain damage within minutes.

description_translations.en: Choking in children is a life-threatening emergency. A blocked airway can cause brain damage within minutes.
description_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Choking in children is a life-threatening emergency. A blocked airway can cause brain damage within minutes.
description_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Choking in children is a life-threatening emergency. A blocked airway can cause brain damage within minutes.
description_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Choking in children is a life-threatening emergency. A blocked airway can cause brain damage within minutes.
description_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Choking in children is a life-threatening emergency. A blocked airway can cause brain damage within minutes.

steps.instruction: Encourage the child to cough — if they can cough forcefully, let them.

instruction_translations.en: Encourage the child to cough — if they can cough forcefully, let them.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Encourage the child to cough — if they can cough forcefully, let them.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Encourage the child to cough — if they can cough forcefully, let them.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Encourage the child to cough — if they can cough forcefully, let them.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Encourage the child to cough — if they can cough forcefully, let them.

steps.instruction: Lean the child forward and give 5 firm back blows between the shoulder blades with the heel of your hand.

instruction_translations.en: Lean the child forward and give 5 firm back blows between the shoulder blades with the heel of your hand.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Lean the child forward and give 5 firm back blows between the shoulder blades with the heel of your hand.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Lean the child forward and give 5 firm back blows between the shoulder blades with the heel of your hand.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Lean the child forward and give 5 firm back blows between the shoulder blades with the heel of your hand.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Lean the child forward and give 5 firm back blows between the shoulder blades with the heel of your hand.

steps.instruction: If back blows fail: give 5 abdominal thrusts — kneel behind the child, make a fist above the navel, thrust inward and upward.

instruction_translations.en: If back blows fail: give 5 abdominal thrusts — kneel behind the child, make a fist above the navel, thrust inward and upward.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If back blows fail: give 5 abdominal thrusts — kneel behind the child, make a fist above the navel, thrust inward and upward.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If back blows fail: give 5 abdominal thrusts — kneel behind the child, make a fist above the navel, thrust inward and upward.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If back blows fail: give 5 abdominal thrusts — kneel behind the child, make a fist above the navel, thrust inward and upward.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If back blows fail: give 5 abdominal thrusts — kneel behind the child, make a fist above the navel, thrust inward and upward.

steps.instruction: Alternate 5 back blows and 5 abdominal thrusts.

instruction_translations.en: Alternate 5 back blows and 5 abdominal thrusts.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Alternate 5 back blows and 5 abdominal thrusts.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Alternate 5 back blows and 5 abdominal thrusts.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Alternate 5 back blows and 5 abdominal thrusts.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Alternate 5 back blows and 5 abdominal thrusts.

steps.instruction: If the child loses consciousness, call 112 and begin CPR immediately.

instruction_translations.en: If the child loses consciousness, call 112 and begin CPR immediately.
instruction_translations.ha: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the child loses consciousness, call 112 and begin CPR immediately.
instruction_translations.ig: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the child loses consciousness, call 112 and begin CPR immediately.
instruction_translations.yo: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the child loses consciousness, call 112 and begin CPR immediately.
instruction_translations.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] If the child loses consciousness, call 112 and begin CPR immediately.

do_not: Do not do a blind finger sweep of the mouth.
Do not use adult-force abdominal thrusts on infants.

1.pcm: [NEEDS_REVIEW] Do not use adult-force abdominal thrusts on infants.

hospital_threshold: Always go to hospital after a choking episode, even if resolved.
